title: Getting Started
key_points: Arweave provides a decentralized storage solution using blockchain technology.
To get started with Arweave, you need to set up and run your first miner.
Miners are responsible for maintaining the network and earning AR tokens.
The Getting Started section of the documentation guides you through the setup process.
You can also find information on configuring and running a miner in this section.
limitations: This source is technical documentation, which may not be accessible to all users.
The scope is limited to the Arweave platform and its usage.
No real-world examples or case studies are provided in this source.
asserts: Setting up and running your first Arweave miner is necessary to get started with using the decentralized storage solution.
scope: This documentation asserts the process of setting up and running an Arweave miner for users looking to utilize the platform's decentralized storage capabilities.
